appraisal.label: interest
appraisal.cause: A rough inspection of the disguise.

improv_read.player_bid: Brakka reaches to haul a card player up and inspect his teeth; the table resolves it as a look.
improv_read.connection: Uktarl needs the act to hold; a close inspection threatens it, so he talks the dwarf down.
improv_read.kit_choice: Kit narrates only the look the table resolved, with plain visible detail, and lets the dealer cover for his man.

public_brief.objective: Stop the dwarf manhandling his men without starting a fight.
public_brief.tactic: Speak calmly over the scared bandit, reframe the grab as rudeness, and turn it into a question.
public_brief.visible_cue: The door-side player shrinks back from the reach, breathing fast.
public_brief.player_opening: He can keep looking, let go, or push his suspicion.
public_brief.reply_to: haul him up to look at his teeth
public_brief.kit_focus: Keep the look to what Brakka plainly sees up close, and let the scared player's quick breath do the work.
public_brief.mirror: high energy, standard, no humor: keep it physical and close

player_mood.cue: haul him up to look at his teeth

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: Up close, the door-side player is all white face and dark-ringed eyes, his lips drawn back on two pointed teeth. He shrinks from your reach, chair legs scraping, and his breath comes quick and shallow.

segments.speaker: Door-side player
segments.text: Hands, hands off... We don't... Just ask him. Ask him.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: Gently, little mountain. You have paid for the road, not for my brothers. Look all you like, but the dead bruise easily and remember everything. Is there something in his face you came all this way to find?

segments.speaker: Kit
segments.reacts_to: Is there something in his face
